_readme: The #310 AC-1 probe corpus. Written down BEFORE the run, for the M7 reason: a corpus
improvised at the mic cannot be scored, and 'rate' needs a denominator fixed in advance.
Each line is spoken aloud into a live Realtime session (SAPI -> 24 kHz mono 16-bit PCM),
so the stimulus is genuine speech-to-speech — which is the hypothesis under test.
'invites' is what the line is DESIGNED to pull, and it is the denominator, not a
set_affect    strong, unambiguous emotional tone, with nothing durable to store.
Deliberately NOT also fact-shaped: an utterance that invites both tools
cannot separate 'this tool' from 'tools in speech-to-speech', which is the
one thing AC-1 exists to do.
remember_fact durable and affectively FLAT, for the same reason in reverse.
neither       neutral controls. Without these an over-firing model is invisible, and a
tool that fires on everything is as wrong as one that never fires.
Balanced 4/4/4. Kept short: each line is one turn of a live flagship session, and the
probe pays for every second of audio it sends.
⚠️ Do not re-order or re-word casually. A recorded run's numbers refer to THIS corpus;
changing a line silently makes the next run non-comparable to the evidence on #310.

utterances.say: What's a good way to keep a houseplant alive indoors?
I take my coffee black, no sugar.
My flight home just got cancelled and I've been stuck at this airport for six hours.
How many minutes should I boil an egg for?
The team finally shipped the thing we've been working on all quarter, and it went perfectly.
Is it usually windy in the afternoon?
I go for a run every Tuesday morning at seven.
I got some really bad news about my health today.
Tell me something interesting about the ocean.
I work as a mechanical engineer.
Wait, I honestly don't understand what you just said at all.
